title: Coefficients of a linear endomorphism are fixed finite linear combinations
statement: Let n∈ℕ, let V=BinaryForm ℂ n, let A:V→V be complex linear, and let e:Fin 2→₀ℕ be any exponent index. For r∈Fin(n+1), put d_r=single 0 r.val+single 1 (n−r.val). There exists a function c:Fin(n+1)→ℂ, depending only on n, A, and e, such that for every Q∈V, coeff e((A Q).val)=Σ_{r∈Fin(n+1)} c(r)·coeff d_r(Q.val).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ, ∀ Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), MvPolynomial.coeff e (A Q).val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), c r * MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val
